authFailed.title: Sign-in rejected
authFailed.hint: The server did not accept the credentials or the SSH key. Check them – and whether you are allowed to read this repository.

offline.title: Server not reachable
offline.hint: Check the network connection and the server name in the address.

notFound.title: There is no repository at this address
notFound.hint: Check the spelling. Private repositories respond the same way without the right permissions.

pathExists.title: The folder is already taken
pathExists.hint: Something already exists at this path. Choose a folder that does not exist in the repository yet.

hostKeyUnknown.title: SSH server not confirmed
hostKeyUnknown.hint: The server’s fingerprint was not confirmed. Compare it with the provider’s details and confirm it on the next attempt.

timeout.title: No response from the server
timeout.hint: The connection made no progress for too long and was stopped. Try again later.

notAllowed.title: The submodule cannot be added like this

locked.title: Something else is working in the repository
locked.hint: Wait until the running action is finished, then try again.

failures.nothingLeft: Nothing was left behind in the repository.

field.url: Git does not accept this source.
field.path: Git does not accept this folder.

phase.counting: The server is gathering the data
phase.compressing: The server is packing the data

progress.label: Progress fetching the submodule
progress.waiting: Waiting for the server to respond …

dialog.title: Add submodule
dialog.description: Embeds another repository in a subfolder. A specific commit is recorded; the entry is then staged and ready.

closeWarning.title: The submodule is still being fetched
closeWarning.text: If you cancel now, the half-fetched folder is removed again and nothing is recorded.

cancelled.title: Fetch cancelled
cancelled.text: Nothing was recorded and no folder was left behind. Your input is still there.

url.label: Address
url.required: Enter the address of the repository to embed.
url.hintLocal: Git only accepts a local folder as a submodule if protocol.file.allow is set to “always” in your Git configuration.
url.hint: HTTPS or SSH (git@host:group/library.git). This address ends up in .gitmodules, visible to everyone.

path.label: Folder in the repository
path.hint: Relative to the repository root, e.g. libs/library. The folder must not exist yet.

dialog.targetEmpty: Address and folder together determine what is embedded where.

path.required: Enter the folder the submodule should live in.
path.absolute: The path is relative to the repository – no drive and no leading slash.
path.root: The submodule needs its own folder in the repository.
path.emptySegment: A folder name is missing between two slashes.
path.badChar: The character “{{char}}” is not allowed in folder names.
path.control: The path contains a control character.
path.edges: “{{segment}}” must not start with a space or end with a dot or space.
path.dash: The path must not start with “-”.
path.taken: There is already a submodule at this path.
path.nested: This folder would be inside another submodule.

offer.title_one: One submodule has not been fetched yet
offer.title_other: {{count}} submodules have not been fetched yet
offer.description_one: Its folder is empty so far: {{paths}}. Initializing fetches the recorded commits.
offer.description_other: Their folders are empty so far: {{paths}}. Initializing fetches the recorded commits.

section.title: Submodules
section.pendingTip_one: {{count}} submodule has not been fetched yet; the folders are empty.
section.pendingTip_other: {{count}} submodules have not been fetched yet; the folders are empty.
section.hideHint: bring back via another section’s menu
